name: ESCP Business School
summary: Business school on six European campuses (Berlin, London, Madrid, Paris, Turin, Warsaw); its English bachelor's move you to a new country each year.

ib.text: A high-school diploma such as the IB; no IB-specific requirements published. English: IELTS 6.5 or CAE 180 unless exempt. Online interview.

apply.via: ESCP's website, or UCAS or Common App (one only)

programmes.name: Bachelor in Management (BSc)
programmes.city: Year 1 in Berlin, London, Paris or Turin
programmes.about: Management, economics and law with liberal arts and languages, studied on three ESCP campuses in three countries; taught in English with some classes in French.
programmes.ib: IELTS 6.5 or CAE 180 unless exempt; French B1 (year 2) or C1 (year 3) only if you study in Paris.
programmes.selectionNote: Rolling: transcripts, personal statement and CV, then an online interview with at least two people, faculty included.

separateFrom.name: Bachelor in Management, Science & Technology (BSc)
separateFrom.reason: A different degree: a science-heavy curriculum on a fixed Paris–Turin–London track, with its own fee.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Management, Science & Technology (BSc)
programmes.about: New from September 2027: management combined with maths, computer science and AI, physics, chemistry and life sciences, for students who want to keep science and business open; taught in English.
programmes.ib: Aimed at students strong in maths, science and economics; no set subjects are published yet.

separateFrom.name: Bachelor in Management (BSc)
separateFrom.reason: A different degree: broader management, with a choice of campuses.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Politics, Economics & Management
programmes.city: Sciences Po Reims, then ESCP London and another ESCP campus
programmes.about: Four-year dual degree with Sciences Po, taught in English: a Sciences Po Bachelor of Arts and ESCP's BSc in Management, joining social sciences with management.
programmes.ib: Apply through Sciences Po's international pathway, before 1 March 2027 (so by 28 February); English at C1.
programmes.selectionNote: Joint selection by Sciences Po and ESCP; interviews in English in April or May 2027.

notes: European fees need a valid European passport; the €80 application fee is not refunded, and a €3,500 deposit secures the place.
The BSc in Management is also on UCAS (institution code E79, course N200); apply through one portal only.
Your first two campuses are fixed in the offer; the third depends on the major you choose.
